title: Special Topics in Biology; Sexual Selection in Nature
description:
Prerequisite: BSCI207; Recommended: BSCI360 or BSCI370; or permission of the Instructor.

Sexual selection drives some of the most spectacular, if not bizarre, traits in nature. We will explore how this powerful and pervasive evolutionary force shapes sexual traits and regulates species boundaries. (Sponsoring Dept: BIOL). Acceptable toward Biological Sciences specialization areas: ECEV and GENB (Ecology, Behavior & Organismal).
